candidate_ledger.cp_quote: At least 2 years of records are retained to demonstrate compliance with the system of controls in place to manage hygiene, waste control and pest control.
candidate_ledger.policy_quote: The occupier of an establishment that is registered for a kind of export operations in relation to a kind of prescribed plants or plant products must retain each document:
candidate_ledger.legal_basis_reason: The candidate requires occupiers of registered establishments to retain documents but does not mention a 2-year retention period or the specific systems of hygiene, waste control and pest control. It is a related record-keeping obligation, not the legal grounding for this CP.
candidate_ledger.legal_basis_cp_quote: At least 2 years of records are retained to demonstrate compliance with the system of controls in place to manage hygiene, waste control and pest control.
candidate_ledger.legal_basis_policy_quote: The occupier of an establishment that is registered for a kind of export operations in relation to a kind of prescribed plants or plant products must retain each document:

atoms.proposition: Records are retained for at least 2 years to demonstrate compliance with the system of controls in place to manage hygiene, waste control and pest control.
atoms.criterion_quote: At least 2 years of records are retained to demonstrate compliance with the system of controls in place to manage hygiene, waste control and pest control.

anchors.quote: At least 2 years of records are retained to demonstrate compliance with the system of controls in place to manage hygiene, waste control and pest control.

The exporter must retain each record referred to in subsection (1) for at least 2 years starting on the day the record is made by the exporter or comes into the exporter’s possession (as the case may be).
The person must retain each record referred to in subsection (3) for at least 2 years starting on the day the record is made by the person or comes into the person’s possession (as the case may be).

The manager of the accredited property must retain each record referred to in subsection (1) for at least 2 years starting on the day the record is made by the manager or comes into the manager’s possession (as the case may be).

The occupier of the registered establishment must retain each record referred to in subsection (1) for at least 2 years starting on the day the record is made by the occupier or comes into the occupier’s possession (as the case may be).

notes: The four PRIMARY_NORM candidates (rules2021:11-5(2), rules2021:11-5(4), rules2021:11-6(2), rules2021:11-7(2)) are grouped under SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION in the validated RuleSetRelation. They jointly ground a single holistic proposition rather than separate ALL children, as the CP does not explicitly require each category's records to be independently retained.

Candidates with contract_eligible=false were excluded from basis_candidate_ids, even if they were originally marked as PRIMARY_NORM, because they do not directly ground the CP criterion (e.g., rules2021:11-10(3) applies to authorised officers, not the exporter/establishment).
No ALL/ANY structure is used because the logical relationship between the four provisions is not explicitly cumulative or alternative; they support the same criterion.
